name: blog-chart
description: > Internal capability, not user-invocable: the orchestrator calls it while running blog-write or blog-rewrite to turn research data into dark-mode compatible inline SVG charts (horizontal bar, grouped bar, donut, line, lollipop, area, radar) for HTML or MDX. Produces accessible markup (role=img, aria-labelledby, unique ids), source attribution and transparent backgrounds. Agents cannot call it.
author: AgriciDaniel
